description: This PHP class 'LeaveLeaveEntitlementDecorator' is a decorator for the LeaveLeaveEntitlement entity, providing methods to set associated leave and entitlement objects by their identifiers. It utilizes traits for ORM helper functions and interacts with other entity classes such as Leave and LeaveEntitlement.
